Frequently Asked Questions

Got Questions? We Have Answers.

What makes Fit Ninja different from typical gym loggers? ▾
Fit Ninja is not just a passive notebook. It features 1,324+ animated looping video demos, tactile set steppers with smart rest timers, automated progressive overload calculation (+2.5 kg auto bump), anatomical fatigue heatmaps, and adaptive macro nutrition.
Does Fit Ninja work completely offline? ▾
Yes! Fit Ninja is built with offline-first Progressive Web App (PWA) architecture. Your workouts, rest timers, and exercise guides work seamlessly without any cell reception or Wi-Fi in basement gyms.
Can I cancel my Fit Ninja Pro subscription anytime? ▾
Yes, absolutely. You can cancel your subscription with a single tap in Settings at any time. There are no lock-in contracts or hidden fees.
